summary: New chat requests automatically include a rolling window of the last 50 user and assistant chat messages from saved history.
instructions: Continue chatting normally; no setup is needed. Each new model request includes up to 50 messages in chronological order, counting your current message, and including saved messages from before restarts or service changes. Older messages remain saved but are not sent in that request. This is direct message replay, not a summary. User image attachments within the window are replayed too. Tool output, command-approval prompts, setup notices, errors and release announcements are excluded; active command approvals retain the tool context needed to complete the current request. The chat composer now shows the 50-message context policy. Tests cover the exact limit and order, restart persistence, current-message inclusion, exclusions, credential redaction, image replay, provider translations and replacement of unbounded response chaining. Live model inference was not tested. Large messages or many images can still exceed your selected provider's limits; no service or billing mode is changed automatically.
